item.title: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp for $3.68B
item.description: Intuit acquired the company in 2021 for roughly $12 billion, so it looks like Bending Spoons is getting quite a bargain.

item.title: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues
item.description: In the midst of dealing with the fallout from its ouster of CEO Jensen Huang, Nvidia delivered its latest earnings report this week, with healthy growth and promises that the good times will continue. At the same time, the chipmaker said it will stop selling its H200 chips in China, and it dismissed calls to […]

item.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
item.description: Everful has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform, helping retailers source products from overseas manufacturers.

item.title: Spend management platform Payhawk announces $280M raise, 2B valuation
item.description: Founded in 2018, Payhawk is an enterprise financial management platform that helps companies track and manage expenses and procurement using AI agents.

item.title: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
item.description: With a team of just seven, Unsiloed AI plans to compete with tech giants and specialized startups in the crowded AI document-processing market.

item.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed US robotics companies the data they need
item.description: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups such as Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.

item.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
item.description: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

item.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
item.description: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.

item.title: Science Corporation’s brain tech is worth $3.5 billion after new funding
item.description: Science Corp. raised a $400 million Series D to scale up its anti-blindness business.

item.title: Hank Green is self-funding ClockwiseTV, a curated educational video platform for kids
item.description: Alongside CEO Leslie Morgan, Hank Green set out to create the video platform he wished his kid had.

item.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
item.description: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.

item.title: Island is a new screen-time app that turns staying off your phone into a game
item.description: YC-backed Island turns screen time goals into a farming game, rewarding users with new crops, animals, and more when they stick to their limits.

item.title: After dodging death, battery startup Our Next Energy is now going public
item.description: Our Next Energy is the latest battery startup to go public via SPAC. Does it now have what it needs to survive in the cutthroat battery industry?

item.title: Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM
item.description: Dreamteam has signed up more than 100 customers across 13 countries, with some businesses switching from established CRMs.

item.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
item.description: Bharat Semi says it has secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology with companies, including General Atomics.

item.title: Flaming Hydra’s new Kickstarter campaign rethinks e-book ownership and digital lending
item.description: A new Kickstarter campaign aims to usher in the “return of the human internet.”

item.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
item.description: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

item.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
item.description: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

item.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
item.description: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.

item.title: Phota Labs uses AI to turn everyday photos into professional-looking shots
item.description: Rather than giving consumers yet another photo-editing tool, Phota Labs aims to use advances in AI to automate the editing process so it’s easier for anyone to turn everyday moments into better photos.
